collection.name: Intensive Care Collection
collection.philosophy: Growth support + hair-fiber protection + consistent tracking = a more intentional hair-care strategy.
intro: Each program has a defined treatment cadence. You can personalize your schedule and products, but The Good Coil provides the recommended starting protocol rather than leaving you to figure everything out yourself.

A scientific distinction runs through all three programs: cosmetic hair-fiber care can improve manageability and reduce breakage, while actual follicular growth and medical hair loss require a different level of evidence and sometimes clinical treatment.
collection.timing_note: Eight weeks is long enough to establish habits and observe changes in manageability, breakage and scalp comfort. It is not long enough to reliably judge substantial new hair growth. Scalp hair grows approximately half an inch per month on average, and hair-growth cycles operate over much longer periods.

Helps the appearance, feel, manageability or physical protection of the hair shaft, not necessarily follicular growth.
collection.tracking_note: Higher breakage and tangling scores mean more breakage and tangling; higher manageability and scalp comfort scores mean better. Score the same way every time so your changes are easy to compare.
graduation: Keep the core habits but reduce the intensity of the program where appropriate.
Repeat another eight weeks with adjusted products, cadence or treatment focus.
Move on to a program with a different focus, for example from the hairline program to Mega Growth & Retention.

programs.name: Edge Growth Plan
programs.objective: Create a consistent hairline-care protocol that reduces traction and friction, supports scalp hygiene, conditions fragile hair around the edges and documents changes over time.
pillars: Low-tension styling every day to reduce repeated pulling.
Weekly cleansing to remove excess oil, sweat and buildup.
A consistent scalp-serum step, daily or as the product directs.
Nightly protection to minimize overnight mechanical stress.
assessment: Fullness, visible short hairs, sparse areas
Short broken hairs versus longer shed hairs
Braids, wigs, ponytails, slick styles, extensions
programs.guardrail: If there are smooth or shiny bald areas, progressive recession, loss of follicular openings, pain, inflammation or patchy shedding, seek a dermatologist's assessment. A routine cannot diagnose or reverse scarring hair loss.

rows: Remove excess oil, sweat and buildup

programs.protocol_note: The scalp serum is a core step in this program. You choose the formulation, but the routine intentionally includes consistent scalp-serum application.
science: Promising experimental evidence for hair follicle biology; human topical growth outcomes remain unestablished. EGCG has demonstrated effects on cultured human dermal papilla cells and ex-vivo hair follicles. This is meaningful preliminary research, although it does not establish that a commercial serum regrows human edges.

Promising, with some human trials; overall evidence quality is mixed. Caffeine has a larger body of topical human research than many cosmetic scalp ingredients, but a 2025 systematic review found that most included studies had methodological limitations.
Established cosmetic skin-conditioning ingredient; not established as a standalone hair-regrowth treatment.
Formulation-specific and emerging; do not assume all peptide blends stimulate growth.

Morning: Apply scalp serum according to its instructions.

programs.promise: A more consistent, protective hairline-care routine and a better record of changes.

programs.name: Mega Growth & Retention
programs.objective: Support consistent scalp care while improving the condition and protection of the hair fiber so that more of the hair's naturally produced length can be retained.
programs.intro: This program has two equally important treatment pillars.
pillars: Scalp cleansing, scalp serums and scalp-health monitoring.
Hydration, conditioning, lipids, proteins, bond care and reduced breakage.
programs.assessment_note: Take standardized photographs and record a baseline length measurement using a consistent method.
programs.guardrail: A cosmetic serum is not a substitute for clinically established treatments where a medical hair-loss diagnosis exists.

protocol.title: Length retention
rows: Support treatment of damaged hair fibers
Week 4, if the hair profile supports it

programs.protocol_note: The scalp serum is a core program requirement, not an optional bonus. Select a leave-on scalp formulation designed for your needs and follow its directions. The protein treatment is a scheduled assessment and treatment checkpoint, not an instruction to apply a strong reconstructor regardless of hair condition. Select a suitable product and follow its directions.
products: Hydrolyzed keratin, wheat, rice or silk proteins
science: Studied for its antioxidant properties and its experimental effects on dermal papilla cells and hair follicles. It belongs in the recommended scalp-serum ingredient family.
There are human topical studies, although study quality and product formulations vary.
Lipid-related ingredients with a role in hair-fiber surface conditioning and lipid replenishment. Topical ceramides are not claimed to stimulate follicles.
These can improve lubrication, softness and manageability. Product formulation matters more than simply seeing an oil listed on the label.
Hydrolyzed keratin, wheat, rice and silk proteins. Their film-forming and conditioning effects vary with molecular size, formulation and hair condition.

Hair contains hydrogen, ionic and disulfide bonds. Chemical and thermal treatments can alter hair-fiber structure. Products marketed as bond builders use different technologies, so claims should be assessed individually rather than assuming all products rebuild the same bonds.
Behentrimonium chloride, behentrimonium methosulfate, cationic polymers and fatty alcohols. Conditioning can reduce combing friction and improve manageability.

rows: Deep conditioning, final photos and assessment

Every day: Apply scalp serum according to directions.

wash_day: Apply scheduled treatment: bond treatment, protein treatment or lipid treatment, depending on the week.
Rinse or continue according to product instructions.
programs.wash_day_note: Treatment products with specific application sequences take precedence over this general order.
programs.promise: A structured approach to scalp care and length retention, not a guaranteed growth rate.
